The build passes. The only test class (`AcceptanceTest`) is green — the other two files are support classes (`AcceptanceBase`, `AuditLogCapture`).

## Summary

I implemented customerCode de-duplication in `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`.

The `customerCodeFor(Owner)` method computes a base code of `<REGION>-<HASH8>`. I wrapped its return value in a new `deduplicateCustomerCode(String)` helper that:

- Collects all existing owners' non-null `customerCode` values into a `Set`.
- Returns the base code unchanged when no existing owner carries it.
- Otherwise appends `-<n>`, starting at `n = 2` and incrementing until it finds a value no existing owner already has, then returns that de-duplicated code.

I also added the `java.util.Objects`, `java.util.Set`, and `java.util.stream.Collectors` imports. The de-duplication runs before the new owner is persisted, so it only compares against pre-existing owners.

`./mvnw test` → `BUILD SUCCESS`, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`.
